actions.description:
Approve or Reject Approval Request. Approve or reject an existing timesheet approval request.

Use this endpoint to act on a request previously created with `POST /timesheets/{timesheet_id}/approval`. The response reflects the resulting approval state.

timesheet_id.description: The timesheet's id, a number (list_team_timesheets or list_user_timesheets show them)

actions.name: discard_timesheet_approval
actions.description: Discard Your Approval Request. Retract the caller's previously submitted approval request for a week. The week returns to draft state.

timesheet_id.description: The timesheet's id, a number (list_team_timesheets or list_user_timesheets show them)

reviewer.description: User ID, must be admin in team

actions.name: get_user_profile
actions.description: Get Current User. Retrieve the user that owns the API key. Returns every field of the team member object plus personal settings: timezone, date and time formats, time off permissions, connected integration accounts, and the full team object.

actions.name: list_team_members
actions.description:
Get All Users. List all members of the team, including removed ones. Each member comes back with profile, group, permission, and time tracking policy fields. What you see depends on your own access: `cost` returns `0` unless you have the `costs` permission, and `permissions` returns an empty array (`[]`) for members with no elevated access.

Supports `query` for name search and `limit` for pagination — see [Pagination](/pagination).

query.description: Filter users by name or email.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

actions.name: get_webhook
actions.description: Get Webhook. Retrieve a single webhook subscription. Shows a secret: only when the person needs it, never pasted in a chat.

hook_id.description: The webhook's id, a number (list_hooks shows them)

actions.name: update_webhook
actions.description: Update Webhook. Update a webhook's events or scope. The `targetUrl` cannot be changed and is ignored if sent; the handshake is repeated against the existing URL to confirm it is still reachable. Send `X-Skip-Handshake: 1` to skip it.

hook_id.description: The webhook's id, a number (list_hooks shows them)

events.description: Replacement list of events. `targetUrl` and scope cannot be changed after creation.

actions.name: delete_hook
actions.description: Delete Webhook. Delete a webhook subscription. Stops further deliveries; no event is sent for the deletion itself.

hook_id.description: The webhook's id, a number (list_hooks shows them)

actions.name: list_hooks
actions.description: Get All Webhooks. List all webhook subscriptions created with your API key. Shows a secret: only when the person needs it, never pasted in a chat.

actions.name: create_webhook
actions.description:
Create Webhook. Register a new webhook subscription.

**Handshake:** on create, Everhour sends a POST to the supplied `targetUrl` with an `X-Hook-Secret` header (HMAC-SHA512) and an empty body. The receiver must respond with a 2xx status to complete verification. Send `X-Skip-Handshake: 1` to skip verification when the receiver cannot participate.

**Scope:** a webhook can listen across the whole team or be scoped to a single project. See [Webhooks](/webhooks) for event types, payload structure, and delivery semantics.

project.description: Restrict the subscription to a single project.
